channel.title: Adapt To Life blog
channel.description: Stories from the adaptive sports community, tournament recaps, guides, and the numbers behind the athletes Adapt To Life supports.

item.title: Monster Smash 2026: Six Wheelchair Pickleball Medals in Cincinnati
item.dc:creator: Adapt To Life
item.description: Wheelchair pickleball athletes we support won six medals at Monster Smash 2026 at The Pickle Lodge in Cincinnati, a Halloween tournament weekend that was free for wheelchair athletes.

item.title: The APP Tour's First Wheelchair Division, Vlasic Classic Chicago 2026
item.dc:creator: Adapt To Life
item.description: Juan Ortiz asked the APP Tour for a wheelchair division at the 2026 Vlasic Classic Chicago in Highland Park, and got the APP's first. Five full teams played it.

item.title: How Much Does a Sport Wheelchair Cost? $4,000 to $6,000
item.dc:creator: Adapt To Life
item.description: A sport wheelchair runs $4,000 to $6,000, and insurance doesn't cover it. What athletes need beyond an everyday chair, and how donors close the gap.

item.title: Sponsor Adaptive Athletes in Chicago
item.dc:creator: Adapt To Life
item.description: Sponsor a wheelchair pickleball athlete in Chicago: a night of court time for $225, a year of training for $1,548, travel to tournaments, or a whole program. What it pays for and what you get back.

item.title: Corporate Matching Gifts: Double Your Gift to Adapt To Life
item.dc:creator: Adapt To Life
item.description: Many employers match gifts to 501(c)(3) nonprofits. How to get your gift to Adapt To Life matched, with our legal name, EIN and IRS letter.

item.title: The numbers
item.dc:creator: Adapt To Life
item.description: Every number in our goal for the year ahead, and what each one pays for.

item.title: Juan Ortiz
item.dc:creator: Adapt To Life
item.description: Paralyzed at 14, Hall of Famer in wheelchair softball, dad of three, and Adapt To Life’s first ambassador.

item.title: Karen Atkinson
item.dc:creator: Adapt To Life
item.description: A retired Army captain who golfs standing up, skis, sails and dives, and serves on our board.
